AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MARCH 19, 2019

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  March 19, 2019
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Chang, Lazarro, Criley & Walker
Absent: Thomas
Also present: Planning Manager Brianna Rindge, Contract Planner Jeffrey Graham,
Assistant City Attorney John Cotti, Community Development & Public Works Director Ken
Rukavina

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT CALENDAR – 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5

1.  Housing Element Annual Progress Report.

Actions: Comissioner Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to submit the Housing Element Annual
Progress Report to City Council, the State Department of Housing & Community Development, and
the State Office of Planning Research (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent).

2.  M-1303-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure
  exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 2332 Chelsea Road.
  Lot 15, Block 2211, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  John Himes
  17155 Lisette St.
  Granada Hills, CA 91344
  Owner:  Scott Gerber

Actions: Comissioner Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-
0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) A
new driveway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by City Engineer.

Planning Commission  1
Action Minutes
March 19, 2019
 3.  M-1304-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for the accessory structure
  exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 1215 Granvia
  Altamira. Lot 4, Block 4, Tract 7538. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Kenji Ogawa

Actions: Comissioner Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-
0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The
proposed driveway is nonstandard. The driveway shall be constructed per City standards, providing
no gaps within the City right-of-way.

4.  NC-1647-19; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new second
  story deck at the single family residence located at 2709 Via Elevado. Lot 15, Block 1434,
  Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code
  Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Criss Gunderson
  2417 Sunnyside Ridge Rd.
  Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
  Owner:  Mark Fitzpatrick

Actions: Comissioner Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-
0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions.

5.  NC-1648/G-1628-19; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for additions & remodel of a single family residence located at 4029 Via
  Pavion. Lot 25, Block 6321, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Cauthen Design
  25532 Narbonne Ave. #100
  Lomita, CA 90717
  Owner:  Renzo Ciccone

Actions: Comissioner Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application on consent (4-
0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A
new driveway and walkway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City
Engineer. 2) The AC dike along the property frontage shall be removed and replaced with a
Hollywood Berm per City standards.

Planning Commission  2
Action Minutes
March 19, 2019
 OLD BUSINESS

6.  NC-1635/G-1623-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 629 Via Del Monte. Lot 8, Block
  1615, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative
  Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Tomaro Architecture
  2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd.
  Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner:  Suresh & Veena Jhawar
  5180 Copa De Oro
  Anaheim Hills, CA 92807

Speakers: Bill Morino, Bob Schwartz, Susan Schwartz, Susan Kouzmanoff, Jim Morino, Barton
Gurewitz, Sandy Thomas

Actions: Comissioner Walker moved and Lazarro seconded to approve the application (3-1 in
favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All
nonstandard encroachments shall be removed from the right-of-way (stepping stones, etc). 2) Stairs
exist within public right-of-way and, shall Planning Commission approve this nonstandard
encroachment, the stairs should not be located within the first 5’ behind the curb. The walkway
cannot be steeper than 2% along City right-of-way. The Planning Commission should also require a
License Agreement for any stairs allowed to be placed within the public right-of-way. 3) The
proposed driveway approach is nonstandard. However, staff recommends the Planning Commission
approve the driveway. 4) Runoff from the watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed
project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to an approved drainage outlet/easement.

NEW BUSINESS

7.  M-1307-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure
  exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 3828 Via Palomino.
  Lot 17, Block 6217, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  JMS Designs
  804 Faysmith Rd.
  Torrance, CA 90503
  Owner:  Julia Forester

Actions: Comissioner Lazarro moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor,
Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All
nonstandard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (stepping stones, etc). 2) A new
driveway and walkway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer.

Planning Commission  3
Action Minutes
March 19, 2019
 8.  NC-1648-19; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions &
  remodel at the single family residence located at 2357 Via Anacapa. Lot 31, Block 2211,
  Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code
  Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Phillip Bennett
  6552 E. Via Arboles
  Anaheim, CA 92807
  Owner:  Stan & Melayne Yocum

Speakers:  Moise Innocent

Continued to the April 16, 2019 meeting.

9.  CUP-97-19; Consideration of a Conditional Use Permit Application for upgrades to the
  Palos Verdes Stables located at 4057 Via Opata. Lots 19 & O, Block 6226, Tract 6887 and
  Lot H, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Sections 15301, 15303 & 15323

  Applicant:  Megan & Greg Padilla/ PV Stables
  4057 Via Opata
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner:  City of Palos Verdes Estates

Speakers: Ben Martin, William Cook, Mercedes Martin, Paula Boothe, Robert Sawyer, Lori
Deutchman, Debra McCarthy, Carole Campbell

Actions: Comissioner Lazarro moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in
favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Comply
with unfulfilled recommendations to address storm water pollution developed by McGowan
Consulting during the March 24, 2016 Public Facility Site Visit. 2) Comply with LA County MS4
NPDES Permit requirements for stormwater. 3) The applicant shall continue to make ADA
improvements at the subject site as determined appropriate by City Staff. 4) Limit the total number
of horses at the property to 55. 5) Maintain no less than 20 parking spaces on the property. 6)
Maintain the 16 stall lights adjacent to the Rolling Hills Estates border with no greater than 50-Watt
halogen spot light bulbs. 7) No lights or sound equipment shall be directed toward the Rolling Hills
Estates properties. 8) Plant vegetative screening to a height of 20 feet to prevent the spread of dust
along the southern fence line of riding ring “I” and along the first segment connected to the east end
of the southern fence line of riding ring “I”.

Planning Commission  4
Action Minutes
March 19, 2019
 ITEMS OF INFORMATION

10.  Minor Modifications - Reviewed & filed.

11.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule - Reviewed & filed.

ACTION MINUTES

Thomas absent)
